topic: The Windmill Problem (Geometric Rotation & Convex Hulls)
target_audience: High school students interested in competitive mathematics or geometry

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Concept of a Rotating Ray
lecture_lines: A ray rotates clockwise around an anchor.
The ray encounters a point in space.
The anchor switches to the new point.
animations: Draw a line from point A rotating clockwise using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg]., color #FFFFFF
Highlight point B when the line hits it., color #FFFF00
Pivot the line around point B using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/anchor.svg]., color #00FFFF

sections.title: Problem Definition: The Windmill Motion
lecture_lines: Consider points distributed in a plane.
A line pivots around one point.
The line sweeps until it hits another.
animations: Display points randomly on the screen., color #FFFFFF
Draw a line anchored at one point using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/windmill.svg] as the center anchor., color #FFFF00
Rotate the line until it hits another point., color #00FF00

sections.title: Core Mechanism: Angles and Pivot Switching
lecture_lines: The pivot switches to continue rotation.
animations: Line rotates until it touches a second point using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg] for orientation., color #FFFFFF
Indicate the pivot point switch animation using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pivot.svg]., color #FFFF00
Resume rotation around the new pivot point represented by the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pivot.svg]., color #FF00FF

sections.title: Theorem & Result: The Periodicity
lecture_lines: It completes cycles of finite rotations.
Total turns relate to point permutations.
animations: Show the line completing one full rotation around the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/windmill.svg] icon., color #FFFF00
Display the resulting point configuration., color #00FFFF
Animate the transition to the next cycle using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/windmill.svg] rotation., color #FF00FF

sections.title: Application and Conclusion
lecture_lines: This concept aids convex hull algorithms.
The windmill maps the entire plane.
